name: aspect-ratio
useFor: Use AspectRatio for product shots, video stills and figures so the page does not jump while they load. Give it the ratio as a number (16 / 9) and put it in a Card with corners for the site's framed art.
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its fixed-shape frames (.how__frame at 4:3, .band__frame)
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Holds media at a fixed shape with square corners; an image inside fills it.
